title: Learned Lossless Image Compression with Interleaved Parallel Inference and Irregular Causal Reasoning

problem.claim: Learned lossless image compression must balance the use of decoded spatial priors against computational overhead and parallelism.

gap.claim: Pixel-by-pixel decoding has high computational overhead, while block-based decoding misses spatial priors at the first decoding step and degrades performance.

contributions.claim: Interleaved Parallel Inference enables decoding across block groups to reduce pixels decoded without spatial priors while keeping overhead low.
The Irregular Causal Reasoning Module aligns inference with irregularly available spatial priors for adaptive context-aware prediction and improved coding efficiency.
Three ICRM variants address three scenarios described as collectively covering most real-world cases.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report state-of-the-art compression performance on 9 benchmark datasets and three scenarios.
The authors report up to 20.61% bpd savings compared with representative prior-work baselines.

narrative_sequence.summary: Lossless image compression reconstructs undecoded pixels using already decoded pixels, and existing learned methods use pixel-by-pixel or block-based decoding.
Pixel-by-pixel decoding exploits spatial priors but is computationally expensive, whereas block-based decoding improves parallelism but loses spatial-prior information initially.
IPI reduces decoding without spatial priors while retaining low overhead, and ICRM adapts prediction to irregularly available spatial priors.
Three ICRM variants cover three stated scenarios.
The authors report state-of-the-art compression performance and up to 20.61% bpd savings against representative baselines.

source_observation.claim: Interleaved decoding reduces the number of pixels decoded without spatial priors while preserving low overhead.

interpretation.claim: Interleaving can serve as a compromise between fully sequential inference and highly parallel block inference.

application.claim: For autoregressive systems with parallelism-versus-context tradeoffs, interleave computation so later groups receive more decoded context without requiring fully sequential execution.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether this tradeoff generalizes beyond the stated image-compression settings.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify model architecture, training procedure, benchmark dataset names, or detailed scenario definitions.
The abstract does not provide absolute compression results, runtime measurements, or ablation results.
